pnp:CanvasControlProperty.Value:
We’re excited to welcome Elena Ferretti to Credimus as our new Head of People. With 15 years of HR leadership across European banking, Elena brings the rare mix of transformation experience and hands-on, people-first pragmatism.

Most recently, Elena was VP of Talent & Culture at Nordhaven Group in Frankfurt, where she helped reshape the employee experience strategy across 12 markets and 4,200 employees. Before that, she spent six years at Caspian Capital Partners in London—first leading Learning & Development, then as Senior Director of People Operations—where she launched an award-winning early careers programme that tripled graduate retention within three years.

Elena started her career in organisational psychology consulting at Meridian Advisory in Milan. She holds an MSc in Organisational Behaviour from Bocconi University and is a certified executive coach.

“Culture isn’t a department — it’s a decision made every day. I’m really looking forward to partnering with teams in New York, London, Frankfurt, and Tokyo to build a workplace where people do the best work of their careers.”

Based in Frankfurt and relocating to New York, Elena will lead our people strategy across all four offices—helping us scale with the same care, clarity, and ambition that our customers expect from Credimus.

We’re excited to welcome our 2026 Credimus Graduate Cohort: five graduate analysts joining us this April across London (2), Frankfurt (2), and New York (1).

Selected from more than 2,800 applicants—our most competitive intake yet—this cohort will rotate through three teams over an 18‑month programme, with three six‑month placements across Risk Analytics, Digital Lending, and Compliance.

Each graduate will be paired with a dedicated mentor from senior leadership and will have full access to the Credimus Learning Academy to build technical, commercial, and leadership skills.

This is the third year of the programme, and it’s already delivering impact—92% of graduates have moved into permanent roles.

“This cohort stands out for the mix of analytical depth and real-world curiosity—these grads are ready to learn fast, ask smart questions, and help us build what’s next,” says David Tanaka, Head of Early Careers (Tokyo).

Please say hello when you see them on calls—or in the office.

It’s OK to pause. From May 12–16, Mental Health Awareness Week
lands in New York, London, Frankfurt, and Tokyo with space to reset.

What’s happening

  • Guided meditation: daily at 12:30pm (local time, each office)
  • Senior leader panel + personal stories: Wed, May 14
  • Resilience workshops with external partner Dr. Amara Osei
  • No meetings after 3pm — all week

Starting May 1, we’ve partnered with Headspace — every employee gets
12 months of free access.

“In banking, we’re trained to stay switched on — but sustainable performance
needs recovery time too. This week is a reminder that pausing is part of doing
great work.” — Sofia Lindgren, Wellbeing Team Lead (London)

Need support anytime? Our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) is
available 24/7 and is fully confidential.

Q2 is here, and your individual learning budget is ready: €2,000 for every full-time Credimus employee to invest in your growth. The budget reset on April 1—make sure you use your Q2 allocation by June 30. Unused budget doesn’t roll over.

What it can cover: conferences, certifications, online courses, books, coaching sessions, and language classes.

New this quarter: a pre-approved fast-track list of 15 popular courses (including CFA prep, AWS Cloud, Bloomberg Terminal, and GDPR specialist). If it’s on the list, you can enroll without manager approval.

Submit your expenses through the Learning Portal on the intranet—reimbursement lands within 10 business days.

Last quarter, 74% of us used the full budget. Our Q2 goal is 85% across New York, London, Frankfurt, and Tokyo.

“Your learning is a compounding investment—make it a priority. The new fast-track list is there to help you move faster, with less friction.” — Priya Chakraborty, Chief Learning Officer (New York)
